objective.title: Record the M11 private distribution proposal and verify exact original archive intake

declared.summary: Record Decision's private distribution request and observe the exact original M11 candidate and historical rollback archives without mutation or reconstruction.
declared.value: Preserve the M0-M11 completed plan and M12 ready inventory path. Reuse the RS394 exact archive/DLL/nuspec checks in a separate read-only mode, check the canonical target positions and owner redistribution attestation; do not repeat numerical consumers. The proposal requests explicit approval for the exact two candidate identities and records the remaining full feed/version-policy, guarded publisher rehearsal and physical readback gates. No package publication, reservation, production adoption or plan transition.
debtChanges: Reuse the qualified M11 verifier rather than duplicating archive inspection logic.
Distinguish M11 net10 legacy archive promotion from new net11 source production and calendar version allocation.
Require independently supported exact-archive promotion, owner approval, collision refusal and partial-pair recovery; no ordinary publisher guard bypass.
declared.nextAction: After durable intake evidence, obtain or record explicit operator authorization and qualify only the supported exact-archive promotion route. If blocked or declined, retain the disposition and reconcile M12 readiness before resuming Math 2.0.
